# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c8 P39](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0039), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is considered fat for a young girl and has little imagination. She is known for her malicious smiles and malicious looks.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Josie is vain, malicious, and possesses the sharpest tongue in her class at Queen's. She is prone to sulking when she does not get her way and delights in cheating, boasting, and making envious or spiteful remarks about others. Despite her disagreeable nature, she exhibits a natural skill for walking board fences and lacks imagination. Anne Shirley considers her impossible to like despite making heroic efforts to do so.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032)_

## History

Josie attends Avonlea School alongside Anne Shirley and Diana Barry. During her school years, she frequently engages in petty rivalries, once cheating in class to get ahead of Anne, and later daring Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, resulting in Anne's broken ankle. She participates in the school concert and is promoted to the fifth class, later joining the Queen's Academy prep class. She passes the Entrance exams and attends Queen's Academy, where she earns her Second Class teacher's license. Rather than teaching immediately, she continues her studies at Redmond College, taking a degree course purely for education's sake. After graduating from Queen's, she returns to Redmond for her Sophomore year and eventually plans to return for another year rather than seek employment.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)_
